domains.name: Paper 1: Advanced Accounting (Corporate Accounts, Mergers, Financial Instruments)
Paper 2: Corporate and Other Laws (Companies Act 2013, LLP, SEBI Basics)
Paper 3: Taxation (Income Tax Act + GST — Indirect Tax)

exam_price_notes: ₹2,700 (~$32 USD) per group registration + ₹1,500 exam fee per group
exam_rules: Pen-and-paper examination. No electronic devices or calculators (except as permitted for specific papers). Descriptive answers; OMR for MCQ papers. Negative marking only for objective papers (-0.25 per wrong answer).
id_requirements: ICAI Registration Number + valid government photo ID (Aadhaar, Passport, Driving Licence)

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-18: "GROUP I Paper-1: Advanced Accounting Paper-2: Corporate and Other Laws Paper-3: Taxation Section A: Income-tax Law Section B: Goods and Services Tax Model Test Papers Model Test Paper 3-A May 2026 Onwards"

prerequisites.description: CA Foundation qualified (or degree graduate with direct entry); must register with ICAI

renewal_options: Certificate of Practice (COP) holders need to complete 20 CPE hours/year; CA membership does not expire

retake_policy.notes: Exams held in May and November; no limit on number of attempts

testing_centers.provider: ICAI Regional Offices and Branch Exam Centres
